protocol_variants.title: Ferric Chloride hydrolysis sol
protocol_variants.sample_policy: Independent protocol; do not concatenate with other variants. Within this protocol preserve each named sample; new aliquots/trials need separate state tracks and reference images.

procedure_steps.instruction: Dissolve 2 g ferric chloride in 100 mL boiling water in a 250 mL beaker (water preparation begins on PDF p2).
procedure_steps.observation: This is a stock preparation, not an addition to the final vessel.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Boil another 100 mL water in a separate 250 mL beaker.
procedure_steps.observation: The receiving beaker contains its own water charge.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of the prepared stock drop by drop with stirring; continue boiling.
procedure_steps.observation: A brown hydroxide sol forms; this is not a clear dissolved salt solution.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.
